towns.name: Santa María de Guía de Gran Canaria

paragraphs: En el norte y este, intervalos nubosos con baja probabilidad de lluvias débiles y ocasionales, principalmente durante la primera mitad del día en medianías. En el resto, poco nuboso con intervalos de nubes altas. Temperaturas con pocos cambios, salvo ligeros descensos de las máximas en la vertiente este. Viento moderado de nordeste a este, con intervalos de mayor intensidad en extremos sudeste y noroeste. Brisas en costas del suroeste.

In the north and east, cloudy intervals with low probability of weak and occasional rains, mainly during the first half of the day in medium altitude areas. In the rest, little cloudy with high cloud intervals. Temperatures with few changes, except slight decreases of the maximums in the east slope. Moderate wind from north-east to east, with higher intensity intervals at extremes south-east and northwest. Brisas on the southwest coast.

paragraphs: Poco nuboso con intervalos de nubes altas. En el litoral este se esperan intervalos nubosos durante la primera mitad del día y a últimas horas. Temperaturas mínimas con pocos cambios, salvo ligeros descensos en el norte y este. Máximas sin cambios en costas y en ligero a moderado ascenso en medianías y zonas altas. Viento flojo a moderado de componente este, con brisas en la costa oeste.

Little cloudy with high cloud intervals. On the east coast cloudy intervals are expected during the first half of the day and late hours. Minimum temperatures with few changes, except for slight descents in the north and east. Maximums unchanged in coasts and light to moderate ascent in medium and high altitude areas. Light wind to moderate east component, with breezes on the west coast.

paragraphs: Poco nuboso en general, con intervalos nubosos en zonas de interior durante la tarde, así como en vertientes norte al final del día. No se descarta calima ligera en las islas occidentales. Temperaturas con pocos cambios. Viento flojo con predominio de la componente este durante la primera mitad del día, y de la componente norte durante la segunda.

Little cloudy in general, with cloudy intervals in interior areas during the afternoon, as well as in northern slopes at the end of the day. Atmospheric dust in light suspension on western islands is not ruled out. Temperatures with few changes. light wind with predominance of the eastern component during the first half of the day, and of the northern component during the second.

paragraphs: Intervalos nubosos en vertientes nordeste de las islas de mayor relieve. Poco nuboso con intervalos de nubes altas en el resto de zonas. Temperaturas mínimas con pocos cambios y máximas en ligero descenso. Viento del nordeste flojo a moderado.

Cloudy intervals on northeastern slopes of the islands of greatest relief. Little cloudy with high cloud intervals in the rest of areas. Minimum temperatures with few changes and maximums in slight descent. Wind from the north-east loose to moderate.
